stem: How can the reader tell that Emily enjoyed living in Texas?

options.label: F
options.text: She goes ice-skating with two of her new neighbors.

options.label: G
options.text: She brought a cactus with her to plant at her new home.

options.label: H
options.text: She learned to roller-skate before moving to her new home.

options.label: J
options.text: She notices that the weather is different between the two states.
